source: https://www.fm.gov.om/en/visitors/entry-visas/, https://evisa.rop.gov.om/visa-eligibility?tabId=eiwscr and https://evisa.rop.gov.om/en/frequently-asked-questions, read 2026-08-30. The public pages identify the eligibility questions, conditions and preparation items below. The application itself requires login, so later live validation attributes, regexes, character limits and field error text were not readable; no pattern or length is claimed.

visa_exemption.label: 14-day visa-exemption status
visa_exemption.placeholder: Check the current Foreign Ministry lists
visa_exemption.help: More than 100 countries and regions are covered, but second-group passports need an additional qualifying visa or residence status. GCC citizens do not need a visa.

nationality.label: Nationality as shown in passport
nationality.help: The ROP wizard uses the nationality shown in the passport to determine available visa subtypes.

gcc_residency.label: GCC residence status
gcc_residency.help: The eligibility wizard asks whether the applicant is resident in Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, Saudi Arabia or the UAE and then asks for the GCC country.

visa_subtype.label: Eligible visa subtype
visa_subtype.help: The result supplies eligible visa subtypes, fee details, permitted stay and conditions for the entered answers.

errors.required: Select only a visa subtype shown as eligible

passport_validity.label: Passport validity
passport_validity.help: The ROP FAQ says a normal passport should be valid for at least 6 months before entering Oman.

errors.required: Confirm at least 6 months of passport validity

passport_scan.label: Passport file
passport_scan.placeholder: Readable file, no more than 512 KB
passport_scan.help: The FAQ states that the passport file must not exceed 512 KB.

errors.required: A readable passport file is required

personal_photo.label: Personal photo file
personal_photo.help: The FAQ gives the same 512 KB maximum for the picture upload.

errors.required: A personal photo file is required

email.label: Registered email
email.help: The application, payment receipt and approved electronic visa are sent to the registered email.

errors.required: An accessible email address is required

application_timing.label: Application timing
application_timing.placeholder: Apply at least 4 days before arrival
application_timing.help: The ROP recommends lodging at least 4 days before arrival because processing time varies by application.

errors.required: Leave the recommended application lead time
